verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's own repo says it offers SDKs for 15+ languages, including TypeScript, .NET and Java, with framework integrations such as React and Next.js. Its docs refer to both client-side and server-side SDKs, it publishes OpenFeature providers, and a hands-on community evaluation used its Java/Ruby SDKs, criticising Java error reporting but confirming the SDKs work. Missing for 10: per-language SDK reference docs in the pack (support rests mainly on the README claim), and SDK polish, since a community report says Java SDK error reporting needs improvement.
